stages.title: Stages

finding_relations.title: Relations between findings
finding_relations.note: possible_duplicate: the same statement may have been recorded twice (candidates are never deleted or merged automatically). dependent: findings that are not independent observations. limited_by: a limitation recorded for the finding. ambiguous_identity: a re-import could not tell which earlier finding a changed row corresponds to.

unparsed_content.title: Workbook content that was not turned into structured records

workbook_versions.title: Imported workbook versions
workbook_versions.note: Each imported workbook file is preserved byte-for-byte in the project data directory; sha256 is the hash of that file.

documents.title: Documents
documents.note: One row per stored document with its latest parse snapshot. sha256 is the hash of the preserved file; the file itself is not exported. 'license' is the licence as supplied by the source, empty when none was supplied. parse_status 'image_only' means no text layer was found (no OCR is done).

search_runs.title: Search runs
search_runs.note: One row per search run or search-file import. mode 'fixture' marks bundled synthetic responses, 'live' a provider response. A run describes what one interface returned on one date; it is not a statement that the search was exhaustive. 'exploratory' runs were made under a provisional protocol.

comparison_sets.title: Saved comparison sets
comparison_sets.note: One row per finding of each saved comparison set. A set records a reviewer's compatibility assessment at one moment; is_current is false when a finding changed afterwards. 'quantitative_candidate' means the recorded fields do not rule out a quantitative comparison; nothing is pooled, averaged or ranked.

evidence_map_system_context.title: Evidence map: stage by system
evidence_map_system_context.note: Counts are counts of findings recorded in this project. An empty cell means that no finding is recorded there; it does not mean that no evidence exists. A finding assigned to several stages is counted in each of them (1 finding(s) here); totals count each finding once. Columns are the terms as stored. Terms share a column only where a reviewer mapped them to one normalized term; such columns list their original terms. 'Independent units, at most' counts findings of one experiment, and findings a reviewer related as dependent, once. Independence of the remaining findings was not assessed, so the figure is an upper bound.

Unit and uncertainty are counted for findings that state a number, range or bound; the reference definition for relative quantities only.
